Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 62

“Dwelling on the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment to them; from attachment desire is born, and from desire, anger.”

The famous causal chain begins with something almost innocent — merely dwelling on a thing. Krishna traces catastrophe back to the small, unremarkable act of letting the mind linger.
